  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

args.command: test -s answer.xyz && head -n 5 answer.xyz && printf '\nConfirmed: answer.xyz exists (%s atoms).\n' "$(head -n 1 answer.xyz)"

python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('answer.xyz');lines=p.read_text().splitlines();lines[1]='C27H36O6; stereochemistry from mol_0016.png; MMFF94-optimized; coordinates in angstroms';p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n');assert p.is_file() and len(lines)==int(lines[0])+2
